findings.explanation: Tags Microsoft 365 (`m365`) on a Proxmox VE vzdump hypervisor backup monitoring use case.
Suggests `tstats` on search-time eval variables (`failed`, `ok`, `p95_dur`) which cannot be queried with `tstats` on raw event logs.
findings.quote: Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`_time, failed, ok, p95_dur`).
findings.suggested_fix: Use raw search or field summaries to validate raw vzdump fields (`status`, `duration_sec`, `storage`, `vmid`).

summary: Pervasive title token salad and generic capacity template residue, combined with spurious equipment tags and unaccelerated tstats validation advice.
